**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
No sector was positive on the week: Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive. XLK is the weakest major sector ETF, BELOW TREND (1W: -12.49% | 1M: -18.28%); XLP is in CORRECTION (1W: -2.05% | 1M: +0.52%), while the Tech/Financials ratio is falling (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -16.69%), BELOW TREND; style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US and emerging markets are both BELOW TREND: SPY (1W: -8.56% | 1M: -9.71%) versus EEM (1W: -11.62% | 1M: -12.77%). India is relatively resilient: INDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.82% | 1M: +11.70%); China remains weak, with FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -3.76%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculative appetite is deteriorating: IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.54% | 1M: -7.25%) and ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -14.36% | 1M: -21.55%). Crypto is weaker still: IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -15.20% | 1M: -28.31%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Broad commodity weakness: CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -9.88% | 1M: -14.43%) and GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -9.17% | 1M: -12.50%). Natural gas is an exception, with UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +6.77%).

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy equities and oil remain weak: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -6.85% | 1M: -10.45%) and BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.34% | 1M: -14.35%). Natural gas is stronger: UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +6.77%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
Confirmed weakness: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -8.56% | 1M: -9.71%), XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -12.49% | 1M: -18.28%), and VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +45.81% | 1M: +47.78%). TLT is also ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.61% | 1M: +0.06%); the supplied divergence alerts are limited to XLP, LQD, and TIP, not a major divergence across core ETFs.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Maintain a defensive posture: favor duration exposure through TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.61% | 1M: +0.06%) and monitor credit stress through HYG/LQD, falling (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -0.65%), BELOW TREND. Reduce exposure to technology and speculative risk while XLK remains BELOW TREND (1W: -12.49% | 1M: -18.28%) and ARKK remains BELOW TREND (1W: -14.36% | 1M: -21.55%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**

BEARISH: If breadth stays at 0/11 and selling persists, reduce exposure to XLK, BELOW TREND (1W: -12.49% | 1M: -18.28%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: If momentum holds, monitor UNG, ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +6.77%).  
BEARISH: If broad commodity weakness continues, watch CPER, BELOW TREND (1W: -9.88% | 1M: -14.43%).

**13. Key Levels?**  
VIX 27.31, rising (1W: +32.83% | 1M: +45.89%), ABOVE TREND; HYG/LQD 0.7361, falling (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -0.65%), BELOW TREND. SPY/TLT 8.4691, falling (1W: -9.15% | 1M: -9.73%), BELOW TREND; Tech/Financials ratio 2.7306, falling (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -16.69%), BELOW TREND.

Relative strength is concentrated in India via INDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.82% | 1M: +11.70%) and natural gas via UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +6.77%); sector style has no clear leadership. Monitor elevated fear through VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +45.81% | 1M: +47.78%) and falling credit ratio HYG/LQD (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -0.65%), BELOW TREND.
